output.summary: A genus of mostly evergreen trees and shrubs native from Africa and Madagascar through southern Asia to the Pacific. Many have glossy foliage; a few yield rose-apple fruits eaten fresh or made into preserves, while the unopened buds of Syzygium aromaticum are the spice clove.
output.edibilityNote: A few species have fruits eaten fresh or preserved; unopened flower buds of Syzygium aromaticum are used as clove spice.
